description.value: Wild Renfrew (OSM: Wild Coast Wilderness Resort) is a multi-unit wilderness resort in Port Renfrew at the western terminus of the West Coast Road, where forest, river, and sea converge roughly two hours from Victoria. The property spans seaside cottages, forest view domes and studios, and a West Coast Trail Lodge, catering to a range of budgets and party sizes. An on-site waterfront pub — the Renfrew Pub — offers draught beer and food year-round, making it a natural end-of-day stop for cyclists finishing a long coastal ride.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at wildrenfrew.com operates under the brand 'Wild Renfrew,' not 'Wild Coast Wilderness Resort' as listed in OSM, though the email domain wcwr.ca suggests a legacy name connection. The website phone (250.647.5541) differs from the OSM phone (+1-250-647-5468), and the website states the check-in address is 17293 Parkinson Road while OSM records 17268 Parkinson Road — both discrepancies are flagged. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike storage, tools, laundry, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website; the Renfrew Pub is confirmed on-site and described as within walking distance of the lodging, providing nearby evening food.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM name is 'Wild Coast Wilderness Resort' but the website brand is consistently 'Wild Renfrew'; email domain wcwr.ca suggests the OSM name may be an older or alternate legal name.
Phone discrepancy: OSM records +1-250-647-5468 but the website prominently displays 250.647.5541.
Address discrepancy: OSM records 17268 Parkinson Road but the website states 'Our accommodation check in & gift shop address is 17293 Parkinson Road.'
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operating wilderness resort and pub at a key destination on Vancouver Island's west coast; actively taking reservations with a live website dated 2026.
